capabilities: Insert an inline-rss code block listing one feed per line
Render feed posts as a Title / Source / Date table, newest first
Refresh feeds on a timer, via a link, or with the Refresh feeds command
Cache fetched results in the plugin's data.json for instant startup
Limit rows with max, per-feed and refresh options
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents that the only network requests are the feed URLs listed in notes, with no telemetry, and that nothing is written to the user's notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display external feed content inside notes; users wanting a dashboard of RSS or Atom updates must leave the app or copy content manually.
summary: Renders the latest posts from RSS and Atom feeds as a table inside any note via an inline-rss code block, without writing anything to the vault.
